source_provision:
### Master Doctrine Matrix: Diversion vs. Application of Income

| Parameter | Diversion of Income by Overriding Charge | Application of Income |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage of Accrual** | Income is diverted **before** reaching the assessee at the source. | Income **reaches** the assessee first, and is then applied/spent. |
| **Nature of Obligation** | Enforceable **overriding legal obligation** attached to the source. | Voluntary or post-receipt legal obligation (personal charge). |
| **Condition of Acquisition** | Obligation accepted as a condition for acquiring the income-generating asset. | Obligation created after acquiring the asset or independently. |
| **Tax Treatment** | Not taxable in the hands of the assessee (**Deductible / Excluded**). | Fully taxable in the hands of the assessee (**No deduction**). |


#### Statutory & Judicial Test Checklist

- **The Source Test (*Sitaldas Tirathdas* Benchmark)**: Is the obligation attached to the source of income itself, creating an overriding title in favour of a third party?
- **Condition of Acquisition Test (*Jit & Pal X-Rays* Benchmark)**: If an obligation is created under a transfer deed as an essential condition to acquire a going concern or asset, it constitutes an overriding charge diverting the income at source.


> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Judicial Precedent Trap**: A charge created on net profits as a prerequisite condition of purchasing a business entity is an **overriding legal charge** (Diversion), whereas a charge created voluntarily post-acquisition for family maintenance or debt repayment is an **application of income**.

director.justification: The question evaluates whether a contractual payment under a sale deed constitutes diversion or application of income by applying the precedent established in Jit & Pal X-Rays (P.) Ltd. v. CIT.
director.visual_metaphor: A diversion pipe diverting water at the source spring versus a bucket used to scoop water after it reaches the reservoir.

Diversion of Income എന്നത് overriding legal obligation വഴി വരുമാനം അസ്സസ്സീയിലേക്ക് എത്തുന്നതിന് മുൻപേ വഴിതിരിച്ചുവിടുന്നതാണ്. എന്നാൽ Application of Income-ൽ വരുമാനം ആദ്യം അസ്സസ്സീയുടെ കയ്യിൽ എത്തുകയും, പിന്നീട് അത് ഉപയോഗിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
